title: Ultrascan
category: Social Media Design • Outdoor Advertising • Editorial Design • Stationery • Print Design
description: Ultrascan is a medical and diagnostic brand for which a wide range of visual communication materials was developed. The project focused on creating consistent and engaging designs for social media, outdoor advertising, certificates, educational books, vehicle branding, and stationery. The visual system uses a bold yellow, red, white, and dark navy palette to create a recognizable and energetic communication style across different applications.
challenge: Ultrascan required a broad visual communication system capable of supporting different types of medical and promotional content while maintaining a consistent brand presence. The designs needed to communicate medical information in an accessible and visually engaging way across digital and printed formats, while also adapting effectively to large-scale outdoor applications, educational publications, certificates, vehicle graphics, and stationery materials.
solution: A comprehensive set of branded communication materials was developed using a consistent visual language centered around strong yellow backgrounds, red accents, white typography, dark navy elements, medical imagery, and prominent promotional compositions. The work included more than 250 social media designs covering educational, promotional, seasonal, and informational content. Outdoor applications included billboard designs and full vehicle branding. Professional certificate designs were created for medical and educational purposes, while books were designed across both covers and interior pages for subjects such as fetal echocardiography and gynecology. The identity was further extended into branded stationery and additional printed communication materials, creating a unified visual presence across both digital and physical touchpoints.
results: The project established a versatile visual communication system for Ultrascan that could be applied consistently across social media, advertising, educational materials, transportation, certificates, and stationery. The combination of a strong color palette, clear information hierarchy, medical imagery, and repeatable graphic elements allowed the brand to maintain visual recognition while adapting its communication style to different formats and audiences.
